command:
set -u
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"

if command -v setfacl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v getfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'acl_tools=present\n'; else printf 'acl_tools=absent\n'; fi

command:
set -eu
if ! getent group platform >/dev/null 2>&1; then groupadd platform; fi
install -d -o root -g platform -m 2770 /srv/platform
chown root:platform /srv/platform
chmod 2770 /srv/platform
printf 'configured\n'

install -d -o root -g platform -m 2770 /srv/platform
chown root:platform /srv/platform
chmod 2770 /srv/platform
printf 'configured\n'

set -eu
platform_gid=$(getent group platform | cut -d: -f3)
test -n "$platform_gid"
test "$(stat -c %U /srv/platform)" = root
test "$(stat -c %G /srv/platform)" = platform
test "$(stat -c %a /srv/platform)" = 2770
rm -f /srv/platform/.restart-proof
setpriv --reuid=61111 --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups sh -c 'umask 0007; printf "member-a\n" > /srv/platform/.restart-proof'
setpriv --reuid=61112 --regid="$platform_gid" --clear-groups sh -c 'printf "member-b\n" >> /srv/platform/.restart-proof'
if setpriv --reuid=61113 --regid=61113 --clear-groups sh -c 'ls /srv/platform >/dev/null 2>&1'; then printf 'outsider_list=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'outsider_list=denied\n'; fi
if setpriv --reuid=61113 --regid=61113 --clear-groups sh -c 'cat /srv/platform/.restart-proof >/dev/null 2>&1'; then printf 'outsider_read=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; exit 1; else printf 'outsider_read=denied\n'; fi
if setpriv --reuid=61113 --regid=61113 --clear-groups sh -c 'touch /srv/platform/.outsider-write >/dev/null 2>&1'; then printf 'outsider_write=UNEXPECTEDLY_ALLOWED\n'; rm -f /srv/platform/.outsider-write; exit 1; else printf 'outsider_write=denied\n'; fi
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
getent group platform
stat -c 'workspace=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/platform
stat -c 'probe=%n uid=%u group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /srv/platform/.restart-proof
printf 'probe_content='; tr '\n' ',' < /srv/platform/.restart-proof; printf '\n'
printf 'member_collaboration=verified\n'
